pins.title: Northern Neck Virginia Vacation Rental on the Water
pins.description: A three bedroom waterfront cottage on Virginia's Northern Neck, where the Potomac meets the Chesapeake Bay. Private dock, cedar sauna, hot tub, two screened porches, sleeps six.
pins.altText: The screened porch at Captain's Cottage looking west over the creek at golden hour.

pins.title: Waterfront Cottage with a Private Dock, Virginia
pins.description: A 1940s waterfront cottage on a quiet tidal creek near Heathsville, Virginia. Swim from the dock, pull a crab pot, and watch the water go gold every clear evening.
pins.altText: A bedroom at Captain's Cottage with an upholstered headboard and soft natural light.

pins.title: Chesapeake Bay Cottage Rental, Northern Neck VA
pins.description: Three bedrooms, two screened porches, a dock, a cedar sauna, and a hot tub on Virginia's Northern Neck. Two hours forty five minutes from Washington DC with no bay crossing.
pins.altText: The living room at Captain's Cottage, rattan chairs and a vintage rug in lamplight.
